description: The pie chart, labeled Figure 3, represents the domain distribution of the AttrEval-GenSearch test set across 12 domains. The largest slice, "AI/NLP Research," is colored blue and accounts for approximately 24.3% of the total. Other notable slices include "Econ. & Fin." (teal, 18.4%), "History" (light green, 8.2%), and "Game&Anime" (orange, 8.2%). The remaining slices are smaller, with "Math" (dark green, 1.2%) being the smallest. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in no particular order. A legend is not provided, but the color of each slice is distinguishable. Overall, the chart provides a clear visual representation of the domain distribution in the AttrEval-GenSearch test set.
